text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- High level Filipino delegation to start two-day visit to Bahrain on Wednesday.
- Gulf Cooperation Council states should unify job safety laws, labour minister says.
- Flat ownership right in Bahrain should be extended to resident expatriates, businessmen say.
- Collection ends on Tuesday for a fund raised to help two Indian girls orphaned after an arson attack in Bahrain in which four Indians were killed.
- A proposed Bahraini-U.S. joint venture company is hoping to spend an estimated $30 million to develop tourism on the island.
- Electricity and water minister signs a 650,000 dinar deal with a Swedish consultant group, Sweco VBB, to provide engineering services for a new water desalination plant.
- Gulf International Bank posts $52.7 million net profit in the first half of 1997.
